name: saudy-api-monolith
description: Saudy monolithic API built from auth, accounts, admin, care and procedures services

scripts.dev: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.start: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run seed && node dist/server.js
scripts.start:with-seed: pnpm exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run seed && pnpm run dev
